We've known each other for what seems forever. Since junior year, but who's counting? You were always the softspoken, innocent girl of the group, I guess I didn't really even realize you for who you were. Granted, I was dating someone else at the time, but we all knew that was spiraling out of control and headed downhill real quick. And then summer hit, and everyone split. Me to an island thousands of miles away, you to somewhere else in the state for school, and our group sort of started floating. We group texted every now and then, but that was it.

And then you went to Spain. Something about an internship, and accounting. It was a 12 hour time difference, so I was up before you went to bed, and you were up before I did. You sent me a message, and for almost two months we talked and we talked; sharing personalities across each other's minds, and it happened so naturally I don't think either of us realized we were doing it. You told me about the existence of your crush, your love for military uniforms, how you wanted your future family to be, and all sorts of things like that. I told you about my fear of parenting, my hopes for the future, and the things I found attractive in a partner.

And then it finally hit me right under the lungs as I realized: I was your crush. I was the person you were dreaming about in your future. And in that moment, everything shifted and clicked together for me. To be sure, I couldn't (and can't) know how things will turn out, but for the first time in my life, a girl pursued me and reciprocated interest. We aren't exactly alike. Our interests are sparsely interwoven. But our hearts are similar, and everything can flow from there. I know you'll try your hardest to make this work, and I want you to know so will I. We won't always agree. I will hurt you. You'll hurt me. Sometimes we'll just want to walk away. But we won't, because even if I hate your actions from time to time, I will always love your soul.

And maybe we won't last. Maybe we'll crash and burn.

But hell, I'll risk it.
Sometimes I go back and read our messages, too.
